PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate varchar2(20);
BEGIN

 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00' ;

 --:global.program_version := '02';

 -- fix for chapter specific drives, fix for default schedule id ran last time for that chapter

 begin
 select schedule_id,to_char(start_date,'MM-DD-RR'),to_char(end_date ,'MM-DD-RR'),
 to_char(start_date,'DY'),to_char(end_date,'DY'),
 nvl(mixfc,0) , nvl(mixtm,0), nvl(nooff,0), nvl(ovtim,0), nvl(parta,0), nvl(recov,0), nvl(untim,0)

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This procedure calculates the hours for a staff in a schedule. This considers piggybacks also.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

PROCEDURE calc_hours_on_schedule (p_staff_no in varchar2,
 p_schedule_id in varchar2,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 hours out number) IS
 act_start date ;
 act_end date ;
 last_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 last_date date ;
 last_hours number ;
 last_start date ;
 pb_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 counter number := 0 ;
 sub_time number;
 add_time number;
 cursor c1 is
 select ssd.drive_id,drive_date from staff_schedule_details ssd,drives
 where ssd.schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and ssd.chapter_id = p_chapter_id 
 and drives.drive_id = ssd.drive_id
 and drives.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 order by schedule_start_time asc ;
BEGIN
 hours := 0 ;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
--message(c1rec.drive_id || ' ' || counter);
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 /*-- Check if this drive is piggybacked to the last one --*/
 if counter >= 0 then
---1
 if c1rec.drive_date = last_date then
---2
 begin
 select drive_id into pb_drive_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = (select drive_group_id from drive_groups
 where drive_id = last_drive_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id)
 and drive_id != last_drive_id ;
 if pb_drive_id = c1rec.drive_id then
---3
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = p_schedule_id
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and STAFF_NO = p_staff_no);
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;

 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 hours := last_hours + (act_end - last_start) * 24 *60 ;
 act_end := act_start ;
 end if ;
---3 END
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
---2 END
 else
---1 ELSE
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = p_schedule_id
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 AND STAFF_NO = p_staff_no) ;
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 end if ;
---1 END
 last_hours := hours ;
 hours := hours + (act_end - act_start)*24 *60 ;
 last_drive_id := c1rec.drive_id ;
 last_date := c1rec.drive_date ;
 last_start := act_start ;
 counter := counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
END;

PROCEDURE check_recovery_time (p_staff_no in varchar2,p_drive_id in varchar2,p_drive_date in date) IS
 dummy_date date ;
 previous_day_end date;
 cur_day_start date ;
 cur_day_end date ;
 next_day_start date ;
 v_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 v_date date;
BEGIN
v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 calc_drive_sch_times(p_drive_id,cur_day_start,cur_day_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;

 /*-- Get previous day's drive and check recovery time. Currently checking is done
 based on current schedule only. --*/

 if p_drive_date - 1 >= to_date(:s_start_date,'MM-DD-RR') then
 begin
 select drive_id into v_drive_id
 from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = :s_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and drive_id in (select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = trunc(v_date) - 1
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;

 calc_drive_sch_times(v_drive_id,dummy_date,previous_day_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 if (cur_day_start - previous_day_end) * 24 < :min_recov_time then
 show_error('12106') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;

 /*-- Get next day's drive and check recovery time. Currently checking is done
 based on current schedule only. --*/
 if p_drive_date + 1 <= to_date(:s_end_date,'MM-DD-RR') then
 begin
 select drive_id into v_drive_id
 from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = :s_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and drive_id in (select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = trunc(v_date) + 1
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 calc_drive_sch_times(v_drive_id,next_day_start,dummy_date,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 if (next_day_start - cur_day_end) * 24 < :min_recov_time then
 show_error('12107') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
END;

PROCEDURE get_part_assign (p_start_date in date,
 p_end_date in date,
 p_schedule_id in varchar2,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2) IS
 -- out_string out varchar2,
 --err_flag out varchar2) IS
 cursor c1 is 
 select /*+ ordered use_nl(drive_estimated_resources */
 drives.drive_id,to_char(drive_date,'MM-DD-RR') drive_date,drive_type,
 nvl(number_reqd,0) number_reqd
 from drives,drive_estimated_resources der
 where drive_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and drives.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and der.drive_id = drives.drive_id
 and der.resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and der.chapter_id = p_chapter_id 
 order by drive_date ;
staff_required number;
staff_assigned number ;
tl_assigned varchar2(1) ;
driver_assigned varchar2(1) ;
miss_desc varchar2(200) ;
counter number := 1 ;
BEGIN
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 /*-- Get number of staff assigned to the drive --*/
 begin
 select nvl(count(*),0) into staff_assigned
 from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error in getting get_part_assign_drives');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end ;
 /*-- Check whether TL is assigned --*/
 begin
 select 'Y' into tl_assigned
 from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and job_code = 'TMLDR'
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then tl_assigned := 'N' ;
 when others then 
 message('Error in getting get_part_assign_drives');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end ;
 /*-- Check whether driver is assigned --*/
 begin
 select 'Y' into driver_assigned
 from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and special_job_code is not null
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then driver_assigned := 'N' ;
 when others then
 message('Error in getting get_part_assign_drives');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end ;
 /*-- Decide whether to display the record --*/
 if staff_assigned < c1rec.number_reqd or tl_assigned = 'N' or driver_assigned = 'N' then
 :part_assign_block.drive_id := c1rec.drive_id;
 :part_assign_block.drive_date := to_date(c1rec.drive_date, 'MM-DD-RR');
 staff_required := ltrim(to_char(c1rec.number_reqd));
 :part_assign_block.staff_reqd := ltrim(to_char(c1rec.number_reqd));
 miss_desc := miss_desc || ':';
 if staff_assigned < c1rec.number_reqd then
 miss_desc := ltrim(to_char(staff_required-staff_assigned))||' '||'staff_less';
 end if;
 if tl_assigned = 'N' and staff_assigned < c1rec.number_reqd then
 miss_desc := miss_desc||':'||'No TL';
 elsif tl_assigned = 'N' then
 miss_desc := 'No TL';
 end if;
 if driver_assigned = 'N' and staff_assigned < c1rec.number_reqd then
 if c1rec.drive_type = 'C' then
 miss_desc := miss_desc||':'||'No coach driver';
 elsif c1rec.drive_type = 'I' then
 miss_desc := miss_desc||':'||'No van driver';
 end if;
 elsif driver_assigned = 'N' then
 if c1rec.drive_type = 'C' then
 miss_desc := 'No coach driver';
 elsif c1rec.drive_type = 'I' then
 miss_desc :='No van driver';
 end if;
 end if;
 :part_assign_block.missing_desc := miss_desc;
 begin
 select sponsor_id,name into :part_assign_block.sponsor_id,
 :part_assign_block.spon_name
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = (select sponsor_id from drive_sponsors

PROCEDURE get_recovery_staff (p_start_date in date,
 p_end_date in date,
 p_schedule_id in varchar2,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2) IS
 
 cursor c1 (v_date date) is 
 select staff_no,first_name||' '||last_name name
 from employees
 where emp_class = 'MSTAF'
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1) ;
 
 v_date date;
 v_staff_no varchar2(6) ;
 v_start_time date ;
 v_end_time date ;
 prev_start_time date ;
 prev_end_time date ;
 act_start_time date ;
 act_end_time date ;
 recov_time varchar2(50);
 curdate date := p_start_date ;
 loop_counter number ;
 temp_string varchar2(2000) ;
 cursor c2 is
 select drive_id,schedule_start_time,schedule_end_time from drives
 where drive_date = curdate + loop_counter
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and drive_id in (select drive_id from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and staff_no = v_staff_no)
 and status = 'CNFRM' ;

 date_range number ;
 selection char(1) ;
 count_recs number := 0 ;
 count_drives_in_day number ;
 count_drives_in_week number ;

 v_sch_start date ;
 v_sch_end date ;
 v_stbk number ;
 v_location_id varchar2(10) ;
 v_travel_time number ;
 counter number :=1;
 min_recov_time number ;
begin
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 begin 
 select distinct nvl(to_number(parameter_value),0) into min_recov_time
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'RECOV';
 --and chapter_id = p_chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error in recovery time');pause;
 end ;

 date_range := p_end_date - p_start_date;

 for c1rec in c1 (v_date) loop
 v_staff_no := c1rec.staff_no ;
 count_drives_in_week := 0 ;

 for i in 0..date_range loop
 loop_counter := i ;
 count_drives_in_day := 0 ;
 for c2rec in c2 loop /*-- looping to check all drives on the day --*/
 /*-- Get the drive timings --*/
 begin
 select schedule_start_time,schedule_end_time,nvl(schedule_stup_bkdown_time,0),location_id
 into v_sch_start,v_sch_end,v_stbk,v_location_id
 from drives
 where drive_id = c2rec.drive_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then v_stbk := 0 ;
 when others then 
 message('Error in drive timings');pause;
 end ;

 begin
 select nvl(travel_time,0) into v_travel_time 
 from locations
 where location_id = v_location_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then v_travel_time := 0 ;
 when others then 
 message('Error in travel time');pause;
 end ;

 act_start_time := v_sch_start - v_travel_time/60/24 - (0.5*v_stbk)/60/24 ;
 act_end_time := v_sch_end + v_travel_time/60/24 + (0.5*v_stbk)/60/24 ;

 count_drives_in_day := count_drives_in_day + 1 ; /*-- Counting no. of drives on the day --*/
 if count_drives_in_day > 1 then /*-- If this is the 2nd drive, check for end and start time
 and change the v_end_time and v_start_time --*/
 if act_end_time > v_end_time then
 v_end_time := act_end_time ;
 end if ;
 if act_start_time < v_start_time then
 v_start_time := act_start_time ;
 end if ;
 else /*-- First drive on the day, set the v_start_time and v_end_time --*/
 v_end_time := act_end_time ;
 v_start_time := act_start_time ;
 end if ;
 end loop ; /*-- end loop c2rec --*/

 if count_drives_in_day > 0 then /*-- Check for recovery time because staff has been assigned
 to a drive on that day --*/
 count_drives_in_week := count_drives_in_week + 1 ;
 if count_drives_in_week > 1 then /*-- After first drive in the week
 , so check for recovery time --*/
 if (v_start_time - prev_end_time) * 24 < min_recov_time then
 /*-- Recovery time violated, show this record --*/
 :recov_block.staff_no := c1rec.staff_no;
 :recov_block.staff_name := c1rec.name;
 recov_time := ltrim(to_char((v_start_time-prev_end_time)*24));
 :recov_block.recovery_time := to_char(trunc(recov_time) * 60/60)
 ||':'||
 lpad(
 to_char(
 mod(recov_time * 60,60)
 )
 ,2,'0');
 :recov_block.recov_date := to_date(to_char(curdate+loop_counter, 'MM-DD-RR'), 'MM-DD-RR');
 :recov_block.seq_no := counter;
 counter := counter +1;
 next_record;
 end if ;
 prev_end_time := v_end_time ;
 prev_start_time := v_start_time ; 
 else /*-- On first drive of the week, so do not check for recovery time. 
 Set the prev_end_time and prev_start_time variables --*/
 prev_end_time := v_end_time ;
 prev_start_time := v_start_time ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 end loop ; /*-- End loop for i --*/
 end loop ; /*-- end loop c1rec --*/
 first_record;
 counter := counter - 1;
 begin
 SELECT NVL(NUMERAL_VALUE,0)*COUNTER
 into :penalty.recov
 FROM VALID_MASTER_CODES 
 WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SCOST'
 AND CODE = 'RECOV';
 set_item_property('penalty.recov',Visual_attribute,'penalty_green');

 exception 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :penalty.recov := -1 ;
 end;
 penalty;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

PROCEDURE staff_weekly_hours (p_schedule_id in varchar2,
 p_staff_no in varchar2,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 tot_hrs out varchar2)IS
cursor c1 is 
 select sto.from_time bod, sto.to_time eod, 'X' drive_id
 from staff_schedule_details std, staff_schedule_hdr sth, staff_off_day sto
 where sto.staff_no = std.staff_no
 and sth.schedule_id = std.schedule_id
 and std.schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and sto.staff_no = p_staff_no
 and sth.status != 'CANCL'
 and sto.unavail_date between sth.start_date and sth.end_date
 and sto.assignment_type = 'WORK'
 union
 select std.actual_bod bod, std.actual_eod eod, std.drive_id drive_id
 from staff_schedule_details std, staff_schedule_hdr sth
 where sth.schedule_id = std.schedule_id
 and std.schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and std.staff_no = p_staff_no
 and std.chapter_id = sth.chapter_id
 and std.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and sth.status != 'CANCL'
 order by 1;

 v_eod date;
 v_bod date;
 total_hours number;
 temp_hours varchar2(50);
 bod_eod number;
 last_bod date;
 last_eod date;
 last_drive varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 bod_eod :=0;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 v_bod := c1rec.bod;
 v_eod := c1rec.eod;
 if trunc(v_bod) = trunc(last_bod) then
 if last_drive != 'X' then
 bod_eod := bod_eod - (last_eod - last_bod)* 24 * 60;
 bod_eod := bod_eod + (v_eod - last_bod) * 24 * 60;
 else
 bod_eod := bod_eod + (v_eod - v_bod)* 24 * 60;
 end if;
 else
 bod_eod := bod_eod + (v_eod - v_bod)* 24 * 60;
 end if;
 total_hours := bod_eod;
 last_bod := c1rec.bod;
 last_eod := c1rec.eod;
 last_drive := c1rec.drive_id;
 end loop;
 temp_hours := to_char(trunc(total_hours/60))
 ||':'||
 lpad(
 to_char(
 mod(total_hours,60)
 )
 ,2,'0');

 tot_hrs := temp_hours; 
END;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'RR'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
